notes.title: SHIFT87 is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

When you are on a roll - you gotta keep on rolling, or something like that. Shortly after releasing our latest title [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/809060/REVEIL/]REVEIL[/url], we already bring you another one: [b]Shift87 launches TODAY[/b]! 

[i]Haven’t watched the trailer yet? Your supervisor has you covered.[/i]
[previewyoutube=xQWRNkLXRzQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Shift87 is a first person observation horror game set in the REVEIL universe. Of course, there is no need to have played REVEIL in order to enjoy Shift87. 

[i]Can you find and report all 66 anomalies? Or will you lose your sanity along the way?[/i]

We are excited to hear about the experiences you make during your shift. Feel free to let us know your feedback via Steam forum or join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/jaegJK9GSt]Discord[/url]!

Thanks again to our publisher Daedalic Entertainment for their trust and, of course, to our community including both everybody who played REVEIL and everybody new (who shows interest in Shift87).  

[i]Well, it’s time to start your own shift now. Please report to your supervisor:[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2981650/Shift_87/

For those curious of both games, we also got a bundle for you!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/43458/Pixelsplit_Horror_Bundle/

Thanks a lot for your support and have a successful shift!

Your Team Pixelsplit
